description: Remote wakeup and reschedule delivery finite independent example
verification_method: research/v3/verify_fixtures.py independently recomputes this declared finite example; implementation and hardware evidence remain separate
mechanism_contract: A task waking on another struct lr_cpu needs an atomic state transition, placement in the destination queue and a reschedule request. The mailbox or queue state is authoritative; the IPI is a doorbell that can coalesce. Checking empty then sleeping must not strand remote work.
required_observation: Every accepted wake either makes the task runnable once or observes it already runnable. Retain a target trace showing remote progress after the receiving struct lr_cpu was idle.
